[[File:Monica Jones portrait.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Monica Jones.]]
'''Monica Jones''' was Marketing Director of Decipher's Specialty Products Group and led the marketing of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref> By November 2001 she was Decipher's vice-president of marketing.<ref name="fcstmt">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Deciphers_Statement_About_Freedom_Con_70203.asp Decipher's Statement About Freedom Con], TheForce.Net (9 November 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012022154/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Deciphers_Statement_About_Freedom_Con_70203.asp Internet Archive]</ref>

== FreedomCon statement ==

On 9 November 2001 Jones wrote Decipher's public statement on [[FreedomCon]]. Decipher would not recognize the event as the World Championships. It could be sanctioned through the tournament program if requirements were met. The 2001 World Championships had been cancelled with DecipherCon.<ref name="fcstmt" /> The Star Wars CCG event is counted as the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].
